Datum.description:
One value with its provenance, or one explicit gap.

A gap is {"value": null, "is_gap": true, "note": ..., "gap_reason": ...}. Every key is present
in both cases.

gap_reason.description: present exactly when value is null
gap_reason.title: Gap Reason

is_gap.description: true exactly when value is null
is_gap.title: Is Gap

scope.description: whether a figure is global or Nepal only
scope.title: Scope

source_url.description: present whenever value is not null
source_url.title: Source Url

value.description: null means no value was found; see gap_reason
value.title: Value

Datum.title: Datum

resolution.description: "stated" = the organisation named this place; "inherited_from_report" = the report was about it
resolution.title: Resolution

EnumsOut.description: Served from core.enums so the frontend never hardcodes a list.
EnumsOut.title: EnumsOut

data.description: every datum by its JSON path, gaps included, e.g. financial_transparency.income
data.title: Data

data_gaps.description: paths that stayed empty after a real search
data_gaps.title: Data Gaps

RegistrationOut.description:
A row with identifier null stays in the response. "The register did not answer" is often
the most honest line on an organisation page.
RegistrationOut.title: RegistrationOut

ResponderFlags.description: Facts about what exists, never a judgement about the organisation.
ResponderFlags.title: ResponderFlags

ResponderItem.description:
One row of the response board.

org is null when an organisation was named in a report but could not be identified. That row
stays visible: "we do not know who this is" is information, not a reason to drop it.
ResponderItem.title: ResponderItem

licence.description: null when the licence could not be verified
licence.title: Licence

SourceRef.description: Where a statement came from. Carries the link, never the article text.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

amount.description: only set when the quote contains the figure
amount.title: Amount

info.description: Who is responding to a disaster, where, since when, and from which source. Every value carries its provenance; a missing value is an explicit, visible state. This API does not rate, score or rank organisations.
info.title: Spenden-Transparenz API
